summary: Dielectric layer containing CoSi2 nanocrystals was directly fabricated by plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition using CoCp2 and NH3 plasma mixed with SiH4 without annealing process. The formation of CoSi2 nanocrystals was confirmed by XPS and GI-XRD. The process provides a simple route for the fabrication of nanocrystal memory compatible with current Si device unit processes.
